name: 75 Rockefeller Plaza
summary: Landmark skyscraper in the heart of Rockefeller Center featuring a mix of offices, retail stores, and restaurants. This iconic Art Deco building attracts both Manhattan professionals and international tourists visiting one of New York City's most famous destinations.
demographics: 75 Rockefeller Plaza attracts a diverse mix of affluent professionals, international tourists, and business executives visiting Midtown Manhattan. The primary demographic includes high-income office workers aged 25-55 with household incomes exceeding $100,000, along with tourists from around the world drawn to the iconic Rockefeller Center complex. The trade area encompasses Manhattan's premier business district, attracting sophisticated shoppers seeking convenience, quality dining, and upscale retail experiences during work hours and lunch breaks.
description: 75 Rockefeller Plaza stands as an iconic landmark skyscraper in the heart of Manhattan's world-famous Rockefeller Center complex, one of the most prestigious addresses in New York City. This historic Art Deco building, part of the legendary Rockefeller Center development completed in the 1930s, seamlessly blends office space with retail and dining establishments, creating a vibrant mixed-use destination. The building houses a carefully curated selection of stores and restaurants that cater to the discerning tastes of Midtown Manhattan's professional workforce and the millions of tourists who visit Rockefeller Center annually. Located steps from iconic attractions like the Top of the Rock observation deck, Radio City Music Hall, and the famous ice skating rink, 75 Rockefeller Plaza benefits from its position at the crossroads of commerce, culture, and tourism. With its prime location on one of the world's most valuable pieces of real estate and its integration into the broader Rockefeller Center ecosystem, this building offers tenants unparalleled visibility and access to an affluent, international customer base.
